bnb.name: Bnb - Banco do Nordeste
bnb.shortDescription: Banco do Nordeste card app, allowing invoice control, limits management and much more.
bnb.longDescription: App developed for Banco do Nordeste, focused on credit card management. Features include invoice control, real-time expense tracking, limit setting, etc. The app was built with Flutter using clean architecture, ensuring scalability and easy maintenance.

banpara.name: Banpara - Banco do Pará
banpara.shortDescription: Credit card solution and expense control for Banpara clients, with multiple features.
banpara.longDescription: Banpara credit card app, developed with Flutter. Features include invoice management, real-time purchase notifications, limit adjustment and digital wallet integration (Apple Pay, Google Pay).

losango.name: Losango - Banco Losango
losango.shortDescription: Losango app for card management, expense control and flexible installments.
losango.longDescription: App development for Banco Losango, offering users expense tracking, installments and direct support. Integrated with a white-label architecture that allowed quick adaptation for other banks.

h2club.name: H2 Club - Groupe H2
h2club.shortDescription: App for tournament management, schedule and H2 club information, with push notifications.
h2club.longDescription: App for H2 Club members, displaying tournament calendar, results, reservations and segmented push notification integration. Implements facial/document recognition for registration and LGPD compliance.

bluec.name: BlueC - Banco BlueC
bluec.shortDescription: BlueC Bank app, integrating digital wallets for immediate payment.
bluec.longDescription: Digital wallet integration (Apple Pay, Google Pay, Samsung Pay) into BlueC app, facilitating contactless payments and real-time transaction management.

afinz.name: Afinz - Banco Afinz
afinz.shortDescription: Afinz Bank with digital banking features, card control and intuitive interface.
afinz.longDescription: Creation of the Afinz Bank app, focused on complete digital banking features: account opening, credit cards, bill payments and service top-ups. Strong emphasis on UI/UX.

komus.name: Komus - Mobile Insurance
komus.shortDescription: Mobile phone insurance app, with plans and integrated support. Brand merged with Pitz Insurance.
komus.longDescription: App developed to offer mobile insurance plans, with claim registration features, repair tracking and 24h support channel. Later, the Komus brand was incorporated into Pitz Insurance.

heiclub.name: HeiClub - Heineken
heiclub.shortDescription: Private project for Heineken clients, with points and digital payment integration.
heiclub.longDescription: Development of internal platform for Heineken, encompassing loyalty program (point redemption) and digital payment method integration. Access restricted to clients and employees.

prudential.name: BackOffice - Prudential
prudential.shortDescription: User management system and XLSX/CSV data export/import.
prudential.longDescription: Internal project for Prudential, including administrative interface for user registration and control. Allows data export to spreadsheets, plus import and automatic mapping of large volumes of information.

neopdv.name: NeoPDV - Dashboard
neopdv.shortDescription: Sales control dashboard and mobile POS for stores, with real-time metrics.
neopdv.longDescription: Solution focused on sales control, allowing salespeople to serve customers away from the cashier (mobile POS) and track goals and metrics through an intuitive web dashboard.

hero.title: About Me
hero.subtitle: Hi! I’m Pedro Ruffo, a developer with 6 years of experience in Flutter, UI/UX Design and web development. I’m passionate about building modern, functional interfaces that deliver exceptional experiences.

summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.content: Mobile Software Engineer - Flutter | Dart | Firebase | Front-end Developer | UI/UX Designer. I have 6 years of experience, especially with Flutter and a strong focus on UI/UX. I love crafting modern, functional and engaging interfaces, ensuring performance and quality in every project.

bullets: Led the development of the LGPD (General Data Protection Law) compliance project, which included a Responsible Gaming website, cookie policy, and a privacy request form with facial and document recognition — all built from the ground up.
Developed the official Grupo H2 Events Website, ensuring a modern, responsive, and user-friendly experience.
Built the Responsible Gaming Website, aligning with LGPD compliance and promoting safe gaming practices
Created the Seu Bet +18 Website and the H2 Bet +18 Website, focusing on age-restricted access and regulatory requirements.
Developed the Unique Poker Tour Website, showcasing tournament details, branding, and registration flows.
Responsible for the H2 Club mobile app, providing users with real-time access to club schedules, tournament tracking, and personal account information.
Designed and implemented the app’s entire JWT-based authentication and security structure, ensuring secure access and data protection.
The app serves H2 Club locations in São Paulo, Curitiba, and Campinas, delivering an integrated and personalized experience for club members.
Implemented push notifications in the H2 app using Flutter, with segmented delivery based on BigQuery data, all managed through FCM tokens.
Banpara, BNB, and Losango – White Label Credit Card App
Developed a white label credit card application for expense tracking, invoice management, purchase analytics, and limit adjustments, using Clean Architecture.
Delivered tailored solutions for each bank, including credit limit control, invoice visualization, and spending categorization.
BlueC – Digital Wallet Integration
Implemented digital wallet features supporting Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Samsung Pay.
Led the full integration of payment methods, focusing on performance, security, and seamless user experience.
Heineken – HeiClub Loyalty Program
Contributed to the HeiClub project, Heineken’s loyalty platform, developing features for point redemption and digital payments.
Collaborated on backend solutions using .NET, ensuring scalability, maintainability, and integration with Heineken’s core systems.
Prudential – Internal Back-Office System
Developed an internal back-office system focused on user management.
Features included exporting user data in XLSX and CSV formats and importing spreadsheets to auto-fill the user database.
Built a user-friendly drag-and-drop interface using Flutter Web, enhancing usability and efficiency for administrative tasks.
Afinz and Bank of Brazil – Mobile Banking Applications
Developed a digital banking app for AFINZ Bank, including full implementation of screens with a strong focus on UI/UX and product design to ensure an intuitive user experience.
Created a credit card management app for Banco do Brasil, providing users with features to control and monitor their cards efficiently.
Komus - Mobile Development
Develop mobile applications using Flutter, with focus on performance, scalability, and clean architecture.
Created the Komus Mobile App, a cell phone insurance application with features for contract management, claims, and plan tracking.
Komus - Web Development
Build responsive and scalable websites using Nuxt.js, Vue.js, Node.js, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and TypeScript.
Developed the Komus Insurance Website, offering users detailed information about mobile protection plans, quote requests, and customer support tools.
neoPDV - Mobile Development
Developed a mobile sales application with integrated POS (checkout), allowing sellers to make transactions both at fixed cashier stations and throughout the store.
Enabled a more dynamic and customer-focused sales approach by allowing mobility within the store environment.
Designed the entire UI/UX of the app, ensuring consistency, usability, and a seamless user experience from checkout to customer interaction.
neoPDV - Web Development
Developed a web-based sales control dashboard for sellers and managers, focused on performance tracking and decision-making.
Implemented interactive charts, metrics, and reports to visualize sales performance and operational data.
Built entirely with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, ensuring accessibility and responsiveness across devices.

footer.description: Developer specialized in modern digital solutions, crafting exceptional experiences with Flutter, Vue.js and cutting-edge technologies.
